meta.title: Sidebar day groups
meta.description: Sections sidebar sessions under today, yesterday, and exact dates, each collapsible with a count, and pinned sessions get their own section. It is applied as four targeted edits to the installed workspace bundle rather than a full patch replay, aligned to DSH 0.2.2-rc.5; after a DSH upgrade run scripts/port-day-groups.mjs to realign.
